target: Exact canonical GitHub checkout with SG062 additive aliases, no historical source modifications, compare ten source SHA256 fingerprints from SG063 and twelve frozen ledger/grid/root SHA256 digests from SG050-SG059 archived evidence.
compare: Hash equality of outputs that each published module itself computes, plus exact byte SHA256 of unchanged source files. Include all mismatches, no silent rewrite or rehashing of original records.
method: CI runs frozen SG064 Python checker via GitHub Actions, emits JSON artifact and fails on any mismatch, reads SG063 and SG050-SG059 published JSON evidence. SG053 outputs two digests, SG056 outputs two, others one each.
acceptance: 10/10 source bytes match SG063 captured fingerprints; 12/12 frozen digests match stored evidence. If any mismatch, record counterexample and continue to SG065 only with explicit blocker.
limitations: A hash equality of published recomputation to a recorded value establishes consistency with that record, not independent source ancestry of the record.
Historical JSON often contains only digest and failure seed summary, not every original detailed stream; compares recomputed digest to the frozen recorded digest.
No real-world generalization inference from synthetic replay.
